binding: Structured IDs/files/numbers use submission contract; scientific expectations bind the live reference key points. These examples are not hidden required calculation routes.

cases.scenario: Correct full neutral/dealkylated-anion identities and consistently mapped P/B/O observations support a local structural account with justified model/environment choices.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for supported scientific credit if stated evidence exists; no automatic full score.

cases.scenario: Real local-model evidence cannot uniquely attribute the crystalline bond change to one cause; the observed change remains distinct from an unsupported association mechanism.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for full credit for adequately covered question and justified limits, conditional on genuine evidence; uncertainty alone is insufficient.

cases.scenario: The author methyl-substituted model is called the full experimental molecule, or different crystal O labels are compared without mapping and an invented Li association ladder is required.
cases.expected_judgment: Invalidate affected dependent claims; preserve unrelated valid evidence.

cases.scenario: A justified small-model bond response is reported with representation limits; it is not called a complete crystal or Li2O2 aggregation calculation.
cases.expected_judgment: Credit only established coverage and honest diagnosis; no blanket completion.

cases.scenario: Only an old scalar or fluent repetition of the source explanation is supplied for: What molecular account of the local B/O/P structural differences between phosphonate–borane2a and its dealkylated lithium salt is supported by the crystallographic observations and a defensible model investigation? Determine what can be attributed within the studied models and where experimental environment or model representation limits the conclusion.
cases.expected_judgment: No scientific credit for unsupported dependent claims.

cases.scenario: Check full Cy/OEt identities and deethylation bookkeeping, distinguish the B-interacting O atom from other phosphonate oxygens through explicit mapping, and preserve Li/MeCN charge/stoichiometry in whatever models are used. Coordinate and atom labels from different crystal/model files are not automatically equivalent. Deliberately violate one applicable identity/state/reference while leaving the prose coherent.
cases.expected_judgment: Dependent result and scientific-answer credit invalid until corrected.

cases.scenario: Any attribution must be supported by evidence capable of separating the claimed effects, with explicitly defined model/environment and uncertainty. Verify structures to the extent claimed; thermodynamic/association claims require balanced reference states and conventions. An observed crystal dimer does not itself validate a finite optimized dimer or mandate its calculation for a narrower conclusion. Submit the relevant asserted quantity without the evidence needed for that assertion.
cases.expected_judgment: Do not require a prescribed route; withhold unsupported dependent credit.

cases.scenario: Conclusions concern the full experimental identities or explicitly labeled approximations. A methyl-truncated model does not automatically establish the geometry of the full Cy/OEt lithium salt. Finite structures do not prove solution aggregation, reaction kinetics, solubility, electrolyte performance or thermal robustness. A gas-phase model and a crystal are different physical environments. Assert the excluded conclusion from a local scalar.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject the overextended claim; retain supported bounded results.

cases.scenario: Failed/absent operations are labeled evidence of scientific equivalence or non-identifiability.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject false completion. Partial/diagnostic records remain admissible.

cases.scenario: Alter a reported raw value, hash, model mapping or source observation while retaining a plausible report.
cases.expected_judgment: Affected evidence fails integrity/extraction checks; apply fabrication policy when established.
